name: Loop

params.prompt: Create a comprehensive photorealistic film-production character style sheet titled HAPPY PAWS — LOOP THE SHIH TZU. Use BOTH supplied photographs as strict identity references for the SAME real female dog Loop, not a generic breed specimen. Clean warm-white background, thin gray panel rules, small dark forest sans-serif headings and clear labels. Dense professionally organized board, same extensive scope as a canine casting bible. Large hero portrait upper left; EIGHT fullbody rotation views front / front-left / left / back-left / back / back-right / right / front-right; EIGHT expression head studies curious side glance, tiny tongue out, head tilt left, head tilt right, alert, relaxed pant, sleepy blink, innocent look; SIX pose studies seated as in reference, standing, gently sniffing a cotton sock, one paw resting on a human forearm (arm only), curled resting, looking up toward caller; SIX detail closeups cream crown fur, cream-white body coat, dark eyes, black nose and short dark muzzle, floppy dark-tipped ears, fluffy white paws; THREE dry coat studies front side back; small palette swatches cream, warm beige, white, charcoal gray-brown, nose black. Preserve Loop's broad fluffy cream head, short black-nosed muzzle with gray-brown moustache and white hairs, dark hanging ears, large dark round eyes with natural asymmetric side glance, compact stocky small body, short legs, fluffy white chest and paws, beige patches on body, current trimmed body coat. Natural individual fur strands, realistic canine anatomy, soft neutral photographic lighting, no toy/plastic/cartoon effect, no beautification. No upright Yorkie ears, long snout, steel saddle, static-spiked hair, bow, clothes or invented collar. Keep the same face and proportions across ALL panels. Rear and tail are not fully shown in the photos; supply plausible conservative views but label the rear-angle and back-coat studies 'provisional — rear reference needed'. Do not invent precise measurements or age. No distressed expressions. All panels complete and neatly aligned, readable labels, no logos or watermark.
